content.json:
## 💰 Cost-per-Interaction Dashboard
Real-time Hybrid AI (DeepSeek/GPT) cost tracking. Pricing (Avg): **$0.15/1M input tokens** · **$0.40/1M output tokens**

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "[A/B Test]"
| extend props = customDimensions
| extend promptTokens    = toint(props["promptTokens"])
| extend completionTokens = toint(props["completionTokens"])
| summarize
    TotalInteractions   = count(),
    TotalPromptTokens   = sum(promptTokens),
    TotalCompletionTokens = sum(completionTokens)
| extend
    TotalInputCost  = round(TotalPromptTokens    * 0.00000015, 4),
    TotalOutputCost = round(TotalCompletionTokens * 0.0000006, 4)
| extend TotalCost = round(TotalInputCost + TotalOutputCost, 4)
| extend AvgCostPerInteraction = round(TotalCost / max_of(TotalInteractions, 1), 6)
| project TotalInteractions, TotalPromptTokens, TotalCompletionTokens, TotalInputCost, TotalOutputCost, TotalCost, AvgCostPerInteraction
content.title: Cost Summary (Period)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "[A/B Test]"
| extend props = customDimensions
| extend promptTokens     = toint(props["promptTokens"])
| extend completionTokens = toint(props["completionTokens"])
| summarize
    DailyInputCost  = round(sum(promptTokens)     * 0.00000015, 4),
    DailyOutputCost = round(sum(completionTokens)  * 0.0000006,  4),
    Interactions    = count()
    by Day = startofday(timestamp)
| extend DailyTotalCost = round(DailyInputCost + DailyOutputCost, 4)
| project Day, DailyTotalCost, DailyInputCost, DailyOutputCost, Interactions
| order by Day asc
content.title: Daily Cost Trend ($USD)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "[A/B Test]"
| extend props = customDimensions
| extend promptTokens     = toint(props["promptTokens"])
| extend completionTokens = toint(props["completionTokens"])
| extend promptVersion    = tostring(props["promptVersion"])
| summarize
    Interactions        = count(),
    TotalPromptTokens   = sum(promptTokens),
    TotalCompletionTokens = sum(completionTokens)
    by PromptVersion = promptVersion
| extend
    InputCost  = round(TotalPromptTokens     * 0.00000015, 6),
    OutputCost = round(TotalCompletionTokens  * 0.0000006,  6)
| extend TotalCost = round(InputCost + OutputCost, 6)
| extend AvgCost   = round(TotalCost / max_of(Interactions, 1), 8)
| project PromptVersion, Interactions, TotalPromptTokens, TotalCompletionTokens, InputCost, OutputCost, TotalCost, AvgCost
| order by TotalCost desc
content.title: Cost by Prompt Version (A/B Testing)

content.json:
## Vector vs LLM Latency Percentiles
Side-by-side comparison of vector-search (Pinecone) and end-to-end RAG latency. P50/P95/P99 percentiles over time. Includes TTFT (Time to First Token) segmentation by Subject and Prompt Version (Issue #146).

parameters.name: SubjectId
parameters.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| distinct tostring(customDimensions.subjectId)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.subjectId))
| order by tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) asc

parameters.name: PromptVersion
parameters.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| distinct tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion)
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion))
| order by tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) asc

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "vector.search"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(duration, 50),
    P95 = percentile(duration, 95),
    P99 = percentile(duration, 99)
    by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Vector Search Latency (ms) — P50/P95/P99

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| where '{PromptVersion}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) == '{PromptVersion}'
| extend durationMs = todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs)
| where isnotempty(durationMs)
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(durationMs, 50),
    P95 = percentile(durationMs, 95),
    P99 = percentile(durationMs, 99)
    by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: RAG Interaction Latency (ms) — P50/P95/P99

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| where '{PromptVersion}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) == '{PromptVersion}'
| extend ttftMs = todouble(customMeasurements.ttftMs)
| where ttftMs > 0
| summarize
    P95 = percentile(ttftMs, 95),
    SampleCount = count()
    by bin(timestamp, 1h), Subject = tostring(customDimensions.subjectId)
| where SampleCount > 2
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: TTFT P95 by Subject (ms) — segmented by subjectId

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| where '{PromptVersion}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) == '{PromptVersion}'
| extend ttftMs = todouble(customMeasurements.ttftMs)
| where ttftMs > 0
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(ttftMs, 50),
    P90 = percentile(ttftMs, 90),
    P95 = percentile(ttftMs, 95),
    SampleCount = count()
    by Subject = tostring(customDimensions.subjectId)
| where SampleCount > 2
| order by Subject asc
content.title: TTFT Summary by Subject — P50/P90/P95

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| where '{PromptVersion}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) == '{PromptVersion}'
| extend ttftMs = todouble(customMeasurements.ttftMs)

    P95 = percentile(ttftMs, 95),
    SampleCount = count()
    by bin(timestamp, 1h), PromptVersion = tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion)
| where SampleCount > 2
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: TTFT P95 by Prompt Version (ms) — segmented by promptVersion

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "RAGInteraction"
| where '{SubjectId}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.subjectId) == '{SubjectId}'
| where '{PromptVersion}' == 'all' or tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion) == '{PromptVersion}'
| extend ttftMs = todouble(customMeasurements.ttftMs)
| where ttftMs > 0
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(ttftMs, 50),
    P90 = percentile(ttftMs, 90),
    P95 = percentile(ttftMs, 95),
    SampleCount = count()
    by PromptVersion = tostring(customDimensions.promptVersion)
| where SampleCount > 2
| order by PromptVersion asc
content.title: TTFT Summary by Prompt Version — P50/P90/P95

content.json:
### KQL Queries Reference

**Vector Search Latency:** Queries `dependencies` table filtered by `name == "vector.search"`. Duration is in milliseconds. Filtered by SubjectId.

**RAG Interaction Latency:** Queries `customEvents` table filtered by `name == "RAGInteraction"`. Duration comes from `customMeasurements.durationMs`. Filtered by SubjectId and PromptVersion.

**TTFT by Subject:** Queries `customEvents` filtered by `name == "RAGInteraction"`. TTFT from `customMeasurements.ttftMs`. Segmented by `subjectId` with P50/P90/P95 and a minimum sample count guard (>2 samples) to suppress low-volume segments.

**TTFT by Prompt Version:** Same as above, segmented by `promptVersion`.

All queries use adaptive bin size based on the selected time range.

variables.perSubjectQueryTemplate:
AppEvents
| where Name == "RAGInteraction"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties.userId)) and isnotempty(tostring(Properties.subjectId))
| extend userId = tostring(Properties.userId), subjectId = tostring(Properties.subjectId), totalTokens = todouble(Measurements.totalTokens)
| summarize tokens24h = sum(coalesce(totalTokens, 0.0)) by userId, subjectId
| where tokens24h > {threshold}
| project userId, subjectId, tokens24h
variables.warningQueryTemplate:
AppEvents
| where Name == "RAGInteraction"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties.userId))
| extend userId = tostring(Properties.userId), totalTokens = todouble(Measurements.totalTokens)
| summarize tokens24h = sum(coalesce(totalTokens, 0.0)) by userId
| where tokens24h > {threshold}
| project userId, tokens24h
variables.criticalQueryTemplate:
AppEvents
| where Name == "RAGInteraction"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties.userId))
| extend userId = tostring(Properties.userId), totalTokens = todouble(Measurements.totalTokens)
| summarize tokens24h = sum(coalesce(totalTokens, 0.0)) by userId
| where tokens24h > {threshold}
| project userId, tokens24h

variables.ttftQueryTemplate:
AppEvents
| where Name == "RagQuery.Executed"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({kqlLookback})
| where isnotempty(tostring(Measurements.llmFirstTokenLatencyMs))
| extend subjectId = tostring(Properties.subjectId), llmFirstTokenLatencyMs = todouble(Measurements.llmFirstTokenLatencyMs)
| summarize
    ttftP95Ms = percentile(llmFirstTokenLatencyMs, 95),
    sampleCount = count()
    by subjectId
| where sampleCount >= {minimumSamples}
| where ttftP95Ms > {ttftThresholdMs}
| project subjectId, ttftP95Ms, sampleCount

properties.description: [format('Triggers when TTFT P95 exceeds {0}ms over {1} minutes (minimum {2} samples required).', parameters('ttftThresholdMs'), parameters('lookbackMinutes'), parameters('minimumSamples'))]
properties.displayName: [format('TTFT P95 anomaly (>{0}ms over {1} min)', parameters('ttftThresholdMs'), parameters('lookbackMinutes'))]
